تستقدموا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْدِمُوا (tastaqdimū) /tas.taq.di.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
# تُسْتَقْدَمُوا (tustaqdamū) /tus.taq.da.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْدَمَ (istaqdama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
